author: happflappy
quote:
Extremely disappointing.
It lost its identity, no GTA style humor, very tame, mostly mundane characters and “small talk” type interactions. No pushing and pulling like with Lamar and Franklin, Trevor and Micheal or a lack of funny side characters like Simeon, the Yogi, Tracy, Jimmy, Franklins aunt etc. The main characters have nothing going for them expect being unreasonably hot for criminals, the look like they’re main casts for love island fss.

I don’t understand how nobody thought to hire someone to improve on this. GTA isn’t just a crime simulator, it has its own identity and the new team didn’t understand it in 13 years of development.
Honestly wished I was there to help them not **** this up.

Gameplan mechanics are to much RDR2, the slo-mo headshots are really horrible, the new camera angle isn’t good, cars are a pain to drive and it’s stressful, they don’t break and are extreme slippery (should add customizable driving physics like how much grip, braking power you want, GTA V was extremely fun because it was really arcade-like.), no first person mode is a shame. Like a big one this game looks really **** beautiful and not having an in car/boat pov is just lazy.

Mission design is the second biggest problem, it’s too repetitive, the pacing is really slow and you have to do 5-6 chores like missions the get one interesting cutscene/mission. It’s just not enough, you can’t play a mostly humorless, really taxing game for hours just to have a few minutes where you go “**** yeah this is gta”.

Should’ve crapped a third of the first chapter and added more fun missions.

The Bonny and Clyde thing is alright but it’s way to much 2k26 relationship sim and not enough crazy in love, ride or die. I mean one of them being silent and mild is okay but both of the characters are just painfully normal. Franklin was fun and had something to him, Micheal was an **** but a fun one and Trevor just was one of the most fun pop culture characters ever.

What I would wish for:

GTAV camera settings, GTAV driving physics in the options or at least an option to decide between “classic” gta driving or modern.
Turning headshot slo-mo’s off.
A option for a little less aggressive cop system at least when you just steal a car.
First person mode in vehicles, no “you need the money on your card to buy this upgrade” situations, it’s just pointless to have to abort tuning just to put cash into the atm, there is a point where realism just **** I mean at this point you could set a limit of 5k a month before the IRS comes questioning and blocks your account. 
Jason’s eye color looks like he got on neon anime contacts from temu, tame them down ffs.

Hot wiring cars seemed fun and clever at first but it’s just boring and tedious, I do appreciate the slim jim and cloning way of stealing cars.

Just give us the options to make it feel more like GTA and less like RDR2, it’s not hard for you, the developers to add these things.

Most importantly the radio is **** ass.

No good pop channel, no good hip hop channel, no good classic hits channel, no good rock or metal channel, no funky edm channel like come on!
Where are your roots rockstar, You could’ve at least taken over 5-6 radio los santos stations and switched their names and a few of their songs around. Maybe an east coast classics would’ve been great, some Nas, Jay Z etc.
And a pop channel, mannnn I just want to Britney, JT, and em. The rock playlist ass as well.

It’s a beautiful game, has some fun missions and is definitely playable but honestly speaking less fun than GTA V or cyberpunk, those are examples of games with great pacing that just pull you into them, I get that we are **** when it comes to attention spans but when we are labored from work we want to have fun, not grind pointless missions and then do chores for a girlfriend that isn’t even fun, she should’ve been a bit more like CJs gf from San Andreas.

And the Mandy thing should’ve been explorable, would’ve loved to see her try to do something to Lucia or the other way around if we tried to mess with her, as we know that Mandy has a very violent secret.

Tldr:

Not enough drama, not enough action, not memorable.

Not fun, funny or iconic.

It’s not a Grand Theft Auto, it’s a politically correct Crime Simulator/RDR3.

PS: given modern political context with Epstein Island, gay Technocrat overlords, the Groypers etc. I expected a lot more smart and funny jabs at all of them.

The best part of this game is the TV Stations, they are great and authentic.

You broke my heart rockstar, you had it all there but were too tame, and took out many things that were good and replaced them with boring stuff.
